title: Electrocardiogram-based Artificial Intelligence to Predict Incident Heart Failure With Preserved vs Reduced Ejection Fraction.
summary: Primary article reports ECG2HF-Subtype developed in 98,190 MGH individuals and tested in MGH/BWH/BIDMC sets; 10-year incident HFrEF/HFpEF discrimination is compared with age/sex and PREVENT-HF logistic model. Retrospective risk prediction only. The result is reported in the Journal of Cardiac Failure. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
